title: Paraphrase-collapse: do diverse models map different questions onto the same answer template?

original_idea.body:
# Paraphrase-collapse

Generate multiple intent-varying paraphrases per base question; query several models and measure within- and cross-model answer collapse (semantically-different paraphrases producing near-identical answers). Paraphrase generation + inference (arXiv 2507.21168).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (shared interpretive collapse is a blind spot) but the catastrophic-risk link is subtle.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 5: generate paraphrases, query models, measure answer collapse; standard tooling.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 5: tightly scoped single experiment (cross-model paraphrase-collapse rate) with clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: open models + paraphrase generation, no internal access, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Directly extends a recent ensembling paper; the paraphrase-collapse-across-models angle is plausibly open.
